boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten map-listed Historic St. Mary’s City destinations immediately beside the college’s practical orbit, each tied to its listed access corridor.

cards.title: Brick Chapel: reconstructed sacred site
cards.subtitle: Hogaboom Lane corridor
cards.notes: Walk the Hogaboom Lane corridor to the museum-listed Brick Chapel and use the exhibit map to place the reconstruction within Historic St. Mary’s City.
cards.short_summary: A named reconstructed chapel on the museum’s exhibit map.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic St. Mary’s City lists The Brick Chapel (ca. 1667) as a visitor exhibit at 18751 Hogaboom Lane.
cards.access_notes: Listed as a visitor exhibit; check the museum’s current visitor information before going.

cards.title: State House: 1676 reconstruction
cards.subtitle: Old State House Road corridor
cards.notes: Follow Old State House Road to this map-listed reconstruction and pair it with the waterfront portion of the historic landscape.
cards.short_summary: A reconstructed 1676 State House beside Old State House Road.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic St. Mary’s City lists the Reconstructed State House of 1676 as a visitor exhibit at 47418 Old State House Road.
cards.access_notes: Listed as a visitor exhibit; check the museum’s current visitor information before going.

cards.title: Town Center: interpretive stop
cards.subtitle: Hogaboom Lane corridor
cards.notes: Use the Hogaboom Lane corridor and the museum exhibit map to find Town Center, then allow time for its named interpretive setting.
cards.short_summary: A named Historic St. Mary’s City visitor-exhibit area.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic St. Mary’s City lists Town Center as a visitor exhibit at 18751 Hogaboom Lane.
cards.access_notes: Listed as a visitor exhibit; check the museum’s current visitor information before going.

cards.title: Mackall Barn: mapped exhibit
cards.subtitle: Hogaboom Lane corridor
cards.notes: Add the Mackall Barn to a Hogaboom Lane walk by locating it on the museum’s exhibit map before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A named barn included among the museum’s visitor exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic St. Mary’s City lists Mackall Barn as a visitor exhibit at 18751 Hogaboom Lane.
cards.access_notes: Listed as a visitor exhibit; check the museum’s current visitor information before going.

cards.title: St. John’s Site: archaeology museum
cards.subtitle: Margaret Brent Way corridor
cards.notes: Take Margaret Brent Way to the St. John’s Site Museum and use it as a focused stop for the museum’s archaeology interpretation.
cards.short_summary: A named site museum on Margaret Brent Way.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic St. Mary’s City lists St. John’s Site Museum as a visitor exhibit at 47645 Margaret Brent Way.
cards.access_notes: Listed as a visitor exhibit; check the museum’s current visitor information before going.

cards.title: Struggle for Freedom: history exhibit
cards.subtitle: Rosecroft Road corridor
cards.notes: Plan a Rosecroft Road stop at this named exhibit and give its historical interpretation dedicated time rather than treating it as a pass-through.
cards.short_summary: A named exhibit documenting African American history at Historic St. Mary’s City.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic St. Mary’s City lists The Struggle for Freedom Exhibit among its visitor exhibits; county tourism locates it at Brome Howard, 18281 Rosecroft Road.
cards.source_title: Historic St. Mary's City — St. Mary's County Tourism
cards.access_notes: County tourism says the exhibit is open during museum hours; confirm current museum hours before travel.

cards.title: Visitor Center: maps and orientation
cards.subtitle: Hogaboom Lane corridor
cards.notes: Start on Hogaboom Lane at the Visitor Center to collect a guide or map and orient yourself before moving through the outdoor grounds.
cards.short_summary: The museum’s starting point for tickets, guides, and orientation.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic St. Mary’s City says its Visitor Center is where visitors can buy tickets, get a visitor guide/map, and learn about museum activities.
cards.source_title: Visitor Center — Historic St. Mary's City
cards.access_notes: The official page lists accessible restrooms, doors, and parking; tickets are available here.

cards.title: Maryland Dove: tall-ship waterfront
cards.subtitle: Old State House Road corridor
cards.notes: Walk Old State House Road to the named waterfront exhibit and look for the Maryland Dove through the museum’s current schedule and map.
cards.short_summary: A museum-listed waterfront exhibit centered on the Maryland Dove.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic St. Mary’s City lists Maryland Dove & the Waterfront as a visitor exhibit at 47414 Old State House Road.
cards.access_notes: Listed as a visitor exhibit; the ship may travel for outreach, so confirm its presence before visiting.

cards.title: Woodland Indian Hamlet: living-history site
cards.subtitle: Hogaboom Lane corridor
cards.notes: Use the Hogaboom Lane exhibit map to locate the Woodland Indian Hamlet and approach it as a dedicated historical interpretation stop.
cards.short_summary: A named visitor exhibit within Historic St. Mary’s City.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic St. Mary’s City lists Woodland Indian Hamlet as a visitor exhibit at 18751 Hogaboom Lane.
cards.access_notes: Listed as a visitor exhibit; check the museum’s current visitor information before going.

cards.title: St. Mary’s Fort: archaeological site
cards.subtitle: Hogaboom Lane corridor
cards.notes: Locate the St. Mary’s Fort Archaeological Site from the Hogaboom Lane exhibit map and keep to the museum’s marked visitor areas.
cards.short_summary: A named archaeological-site exhibit at Historic St. Mary’s City.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic St. Mary’s City lists St. Mary’s Fort Archaeological Site as a visitor exhibit at 18751 Hogaboom Lane.
cards.access_notes: Listed as a visitor exhibit; check the museum’s current visitor information before going.
